_comment: Fast-lookup index of every key file in the Archx repository: inputs, outputs, and single responsibility.

Cargo.toml.purpose: Rust crate manifest for the zero-dependency archx compiler (v0.6.0).

src/main.rs.purpose: CLI driver: flag parsing, extension/clobber checks, temp .ll handling, cross-platform clang invocation (-lm / MSVC), and --run execution.

src/diag.rs.purpose: 1-based source Span and Diagnostic error type.
inputs: line: usize, col: usize, message: String

src/token.rs.purpose: Lexical token enum (including FStrPart, Float, SlashSlash, StarStar, Assert, Pass, With, NoneLit) and token descriptions.

src/lexer.rs.purpose: 4-space indentation-aware UTF-8 lexer with f-string interpolation, float/underscore numbers, and Python keywords.

src/ast.rs.purpose: AST definitions for Program, StructDef (with methods), Func, Stmt, Expr, CallArg, AssignTarget, and Type.

src/parser.rs.purpose: Bounded-depth parser supporting 1:1 Python syntax (def, class, range, enumerate, with region:, script main) and classic syntax.

src/codegen/mod.rs.purpose: LLVM IR module orchestrator, struct/method layout resolution, Codegen state, function frames, and runtime flag finalization.

src/codegen/analysis.rs.purpose: Pure AST static analyses: SoA escape detection, monotonic while stride verification, Pythonic first-binding vs mutation sets, and constant int folding.

src/codegen/stmt.rs.purpose: Statement, Pythonic implicit variable binding, with region:, int/bool/float SoA setup, assert/pass, and assignment lowering.

src/codegen/loops.rs.purpose: while, range/a..b (positive, negative, and dynamic steps), for x in arr, for ch in s, and enumerate lowering.

src/codegen/expr.rs.purpose: Expression lowering: int/float/bool/None/str literals, indexing, fields, // and ** math, inline ternary, in/not in, [v]*n, s*n, and SSO strings.

src/codegen/calls.rs.purpose: User fastcc calls, positional/keyword constructors, int/float/str/bool conversions, and LEGB soft built-ins.

src/codegen/io.rs.purpose: Pythonic console I/O & formatting lowering: print(*args, sep=..., end=...), input([prompt]), str(x), and f-strings.

src/codegen/methods.rs.purpose: class/struct self method definitions & dispatch, list (.append/.pop/.clear), and SSO-aware string methods.

src/codegen/ownership.rs.purpose: Deterministic RAII ownership: statement temporaries, recursive drops, deep clones, and region return heap promotion.

src/codegen/memory.rs.purpose: Checked malloc/calloc/realloc (align 16, 2^47 cap), element store/load/fill loops, and bounds-check elision proofs.

src/codegen/runtime.rs.purpose: Core on-demand LLVM IR runtime helpers (@archx_region_*, @archx_str_*, panic handlers) and core declarations.
outputs: Private LLVM IR helper functions and declares

src/codegen/runtime_py.rs.purpose: On-demand Pythonic LLVM IR runtime helpers (@archx_input, float formatting, string conversions/methods, and assertion/step panics).
outputs: Private LLVM IR helper functions and declares

src/codegen/tests.rs.purpose: Unit tests for LLVM IR codegen, Pythonic float SoA + range bounds elision, SSO strings, and region escape checking.

examples/pythonic.archx.lang.purpose: Runnable showcase of 1:1 Pythonic Archx syntax, methods, f-strings, print(sep=...), float, enumerate, and with region:.

benchmarks/nbody_float.archx.lang.purpose: Suite 4 1:1 Pythonic floating-point N-body & OOP method benchmark beating C -O2 and Rust -O.

tests/cli.rs.purpose: Cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows) end-to-end CLI and execution integration tests including piped stdin input().

benchmarks/run.sh.purpose: Builds, verifies stdout via cmp, and times C vs Rust vs Archx across primes, arrays, composite, and nbody_float suites.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.purpose: 3-OS GitHub Actions CI workflow (Linux, macOS, Windows), ASan+LSan verification, 4-suite benchmarks, and repo-committed logs/test-history.
